cases.rationale: Canonical unauthenticated GET control.
Canonical zero-length POST must reach the origin once; its application status is recorded separately.
cases.request_template:
POST /login?osmap_s03={token} HTTP/1.1
Host: {authority}
Content-Length: 0
Connection: close

cases.rationale: Strict request-line policy rejects leading whitespace.
The strict origin rejects the raw line while the edge may safely canonicalize it into one equivalent request.
HTAB request-line separators are a parser-differential risk.
OSMAP requires CRLF; the edge may safely canonicalize one unambiguous message.
The origin rejects mixed termination while the edge may canonicalize one unambiguous message.
Obsolete folded fields must not be interpreted differently.
cases.request_template:
GET /login?osmap_s03={token} HTTP/1.1
Host: {authority}
X-Test: one
 two
Connection: close

cases.rationale: RFC 9112 requires rejection of whitespace before colon.
SP is not a valid field-name byte.

Host: {authority}
X Bad: value
Connection: close

cases.rationale: Empty authority must fail closed.

cases.rationale: Duplicate Host is rejected even when values agree.
Conflicting authority is a routing differential.

Host: {authority}
Host: attacker.invalid
Connection: close

cases.rationale: Host must not contain path characters.

Host: {authority}/admin
Connection: close
